text:
jamie: Pushed a small rename + ran gofmt on branch feature/refactor-kv. PR #3421 — need one more approval to hit today's EOD merge window. Quick sanity check on naming/lint would be great. https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/3421
ryan: Will review in ~25m. If it's just naming + formatting I can approve quickly.
sumi: Skimmed CI output — one lint error on exported identifier 'KvCache' (style expects all-caps initialisms). Suggest rename to 'KVCache' or add a comment if you intended the lowercase v. Example change: ```diff
- type KvCache struct{}
+ type KVCache struct{}
```
jamie: Ah, I intentionally had the lowercase v to match a previous local naming pattern. Happy to switch to 'KVCache' to satisfy lint.
noah: FYI our style doc calls for initialisms like KV to be all-caps. We standardized this to avoid churn. Recommend renaming.
ci-bot: go-lint failed — exported identifier 'KvCache' should be 'KVCache' (golint/style).
ryan: If the rename is mechanical I'd usually do it in a follow-up, but since it's blocking merge window let's fix here. Jamie, ping me after you push and I'll give a final look. :thumbsup:
jamie: Pushed fix (renamed to KVCache) and ran `gofmt` locally, pushed new commit to branch.
ci-bot: All checks passed — build: success; lint: success.
sumi: Quick follow-up nit — a test still referenced the old name (`cache := NewKvCache()`), small search+replace left.
jamie: Fixed the test reference and pushed another commit. Thanks for catching that. Merging now within the merge window; will monitor post-merge CI.
ryan: :rocket:
noah: Optional: add a tiny CHANGES entry for the rename? Not necessary for internal type but up to you.
jamie: Skipping CHANGES for this one (internal-only, no behavior change). Thanks everyone for fast reviews!
